sql.errorLog.getAllForCompany: select cel.id, cel.company_feature_id, cel.error_message, cel.error_log_status_id, cel.date_created, cel.date_modified, cel.created_by_id, cel.modified_by_id, cel.archived, cf.company_id, els.status as error_log_status from flow.company_error_log cel inner join flow.error_log_status els on els.id = cel.error_log_status_id inner join flow.company_feature cf on cf.id = cel.company_feature_id where cf.company_id = :companyId and cel.archived is not true order by cel.date_created
sql.errorLog.delete: update flow.company_error_log set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
